description.value: Bamboo Inn is a long-established Chinese restaurant on the north side of Kamloops, serving authentic cuisine for over four decades and widely regarded as a local institution. Chefs combine classic Chinese recipes with locally sourced produce for dine-in, takeout, and delivery, and the kitchen also handles banquets and catered events. A touring cyclist passing through the north end of Kamloops will find a reliable sit-down meal or quick takeout option here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and active, confirming the business is open. Phone number matches OSM exactly; however, the postal code on the website footer (V2B 7S6) differs from OSM (V2B 3L9), flagged as a discrepancy. Takeout is confirmed explicitly by the website ('dine-in, take-out, or free delivery within 3 km'); no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all remain null.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM records V2B 3L9 but the website footer consistently shows V2B 7S6 — ground-truth verification needed.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 11:00-21:00) conflict with website claim of Monday–Sunday 11 AM–9 PM; website appears more current.
